articles.title: Amer Sports 2026 Q3 Earnings Call
articles.summary: Amer Sports第三季度收入同比增长24%至21.69亿美元，三大增长品牌带动各板块、地区和渠道均实现两位数增长。调整后毛利率提高1.5个百分点至59.4%，调整后营业利润率提高0.7个百分点至16.4%。管理层上调全年收入、利润率和每股收益指引，同时把业务组合带来的利润率空间继续投入产品、品牌、门店、供应链和数字能力。
highlights: 集团收入同比增长24%，剔除汇率影响后增长23%
调整后毛利率59.4%，同比提高1.5个百分点
调整后营业利润率16.4%，同比提高0.7个百分点
前九个月经营现金流5.14亿美元，库存增速低于收入增速
revenueDrivers: Arc'teryx、Salomon和Wilson Tennis 360继续构成三大增长引擎
技术服装和户外运动分别增长26%和27%
自营门店、电商、批发以及各主要地区均实现两位数增长
marginDrivers: 渠道、地区和产品结构改善
折扣减少、材料成本改善和空运使用下降
部分销售及管理费用由第三季度后移至第四季度
guidance: 2026年调整后营业利润率指引上调至14.5%至14.7%
2027年初步预计收入增速位于长期区间中点，调整后营业利润率提高约0.3个百分点
risks: 第四季度费用增加和高比较基数压低单季利润率与增速
中国和欧洲宏观环境仍具挑战
快速门店与渠道扩张需要库存、供应链和品牌纪律同步提升

articles.title: On Holding 2026 Q3 Earnings Call
articles.summary: On Q3 2026 net sales increased 17.2% reported and 17.8% at constant currency to CHF 931.4 million. DTC grew 25.0% and reached 42.2% of sales. Gross margin was 72.6% including CHF 52.6 million of U.S. tariff refunds and 66.9% excluding them; on a like-for-like basis underlying gross margin expanded around 320 basis points. Adjusted EBITDA margin was 27.6%, or 21.9% excluding tariff refunds, while full-year constant-currency sales guidance remained in the low-20% range and gross-margin guidance excluding refunds rose to around 66%.
highlights: Net sales CHF 931.4 million, +17.2% reported / +17.8% constant currency
DTC +25.0% and 42.2% of sales
Underlying gross margin +320 basis points on a like-for-like basis
Apparel +38.7% reported
Q4 growth expected to accelerate, predominantly DTC-led
articles.revenueDrivers: DTC growth came from younger customers, larger footwear-and-apparel baskets, faster repeat purchasing, ten new stores, apparel expansion and strong APAC demand. Wholesale benefited from improved sell-out, new shelf space and some retailer deliveries pulled forward into Q3.
articles.marginDrivers: Full-price discipline, higher DTC mix, sourcing and manufacturing scale, and CHF 52.6 million of U.S. tariff refunds supported margin. Excluding current tariff refunds and the prior-year freight benefit, gross margin expanded about 320 basis points.
articles.guidance: Full-year 2026 constant-currency net sales growth remains in the low-20% range. Gross margin is expected around 67.5% including tariff refunds and around 66% excluding them; adjusted EBITDA margin is expected at 21.0%-21.5% including refunds and 19.5%-20.0% excluding them.
articles.risks: A promotional U.S. market, quarter-to-quarter channel timing, LightSpray capacity constraints, inventory currency translation, and execution of new sports and technology investment remain the main modeling variables.

articles.title: Alpargatas 2026 Q3 Earnings Call
articles.summary: Alpargatas Q3 2026 net sales reached R$1.240 billion, up 11.1%, with adjusted EBITDA of R$283.5 million and a 22.9% margin. Brazil sell-out grew 8%, international volume increased 14.6%, U.S. volume grew 82%, and international operations delivered their first positive third-quarter EBITDA in five years. Rothy's sales increased 12% to US$51 million, while freight, tariffs, new stores and marketing resulted in negative US$2.2 million EBITDA.
highlights: Net sales increased 11.1% to R$1.240 billion
Adjusted EBITDA increased 10.9% to R$283.5 million
Brazil sell-out increased 8% and grocery market share reached 79.9%
U.S. volume increased 82% with no channel inventory accumulation
Rothy's sales increased 12% to US$51 million
articles.revenueDrivers: Brazil consumer sell-out, disciplined channel replenishment, European growth, U.S. door expansion and recovery in priority distributor markets supported revenue.
articles.marginDrivers: Manufacturing efficiency, scale, favorable mix and a leaner U.S. distributor model supported profitability; payroll-tax reinstatement and long-term-incentive remeasurement pressured fixed expenses, while freight, tariffs and store investment pressured Rothy's.
articles.guidance: Management did not issue formal 2027 guidance. Capital and operating investments will be phased after consumer traction is validated and will undergo scenario-sensitivity and risk review.
articles.risks: Brazil labor and tax reform, raw-material and FX volatility, channel inventory discipline, international execution, Rothy's freight and tariff pressure, and the timing of growth investments.

articles.title: Crocs FY2026 Q3 Earnings Call
articles.summary: Crocs Q3 2026 revenue increased 5% to more than $1 billion, with Crocs Brand up 4% and HEYDUDE up 6%. Management raised full-year revenue and EPS guidance, highlighted HEYDUDE's return to growth, and quantified the North America DTC-to-wholesale business-model shift while maintaining disciplined promotion and inventory management.
articles.revenueDrivers: International Crocs DTC growth, HEYDUDE wholesale recovery, product diversification, easier wholesale comparisons, and social-commerce expansion.
articles.marginDrivers: Lower tariffs, supply-chain cost savings, higher ASPs and channel mix, partially offset by planned product-mix headwinds.
articles.guidance: FY2026 enterprise revenue growth approximately 3%; Crocs Brand approximately 4%; HEYDUDE approximately flat; Q4 enterprise growth 7%-9%; adjusted EPS $14.45-$14.65.
articles.risks: K-shaped consumer pressure, cautious wholesale ordering, elevated input-cost inflation, competitive holiday promotions, and temporary DTC reporting headwinds from the business-model shift.

articles.title: Deckers FY2027 Q2 Earnings Call
articles.summary: Deckers FY2027 Q2 revenue grew 3.5% to $1.48 billion. HOKA and UGG grew 7% and 4%, while U.S. DTC faced heavier promotion and European logistics delays. Underlying gross margin improved 120 basis points before tariff refunds, supported by full-price selling and product mix.
highlights: Revenue rose 3.5% to $1.48 billion
HOKA grew 7% and UGG grew 4%
Underlying gross margin improved 120 basis points
European 3PL delays affected about $22 million of revenue
FY2027 revenue outlook was revised to $5.70-$5.725 billion
articles.revenueDrivers: International and wholesale strength offset U.S. DTC pressure and European logistics disruption.
articles.marginDrivers: Full-price selling and favorable product mix drove 120 basis points of underlying improvement; tariff refunds added 310 basis points in Q2.
articles.guidance: FY2027 revenue is expected at $5.70-$5.725 billion; gross margin about 58.5%; operating margin about 23%; diluted EPS $7.80-$7.95 including received tariff refunds.
articles.risks: U.S. promotional intensity, delayed consumer purchasing, European logistics recovery, order cancellations, freight pressure, and execution of 2027 product transitions.

articles.title: Nike FY2027 Q1 Earnings Call
articles.summary: Nike FY2027 Q1 revenue was $11.2 billion, down 4% reported and 5% currency neutral. Gross margin improved to 42.8% and performance categories grew, while Sportswear, Jordan Brand, and Greater China remained under pressure. Pace savings are expected to scale mainly in FY2029-FY2030.
highlights: Performance portfolio grew high single digits
Greater China revenue declined 26%
Gross margin improved 60 basis points to 42.8%
Pace savings are expected to scale in FY2029-FY2030
FY2027 revenue is expected to decline high single digits
articles.revenueDrivers: Performance running, football, training, basketball, tennis and golf growth offset pressure in Sportswear, Jordan Brand and Greater China.
articles.marginDrivers: Supply-chain cost actions and FX helped gross margin, while discounts, channel mix, fixed-cost deleverage and reset actions remain pressures.
articles.guidance: FY2027 revenue expected to decline high single digits; adjusted EPS expected at $1.15-$1.35 excluding approximately $0.15 of Pace impact.
articles.risks: Greater China reset duration, Sportswear and Jordan repositioning, promotional comparisons, fixed-cost deleverage, and Pace execution.

articles.title: Lululemon FY2026 Q2 Earnings Call
articles.summary: Lululemon FY2026 第二季度收入下降 4% 至 24 亿美元，北美下降 8%；中国大陆按报告口径增长 4%，按固定汇率计算下降 2%。管理层下调全年指引，加快畅销产品追单和品牌投入，并在保护产品与品牌能力的同时深入审视成本基础。
highlights: 第二季度收入下降 4%
北美收入下降 8%
中国大陆按报告口径增长 4%
IEEPA 关税退款增厚营业利润率
全年收入指引下调
articles.revenueDrivers: 客流压力、新品上市反响不稳定、中国品牌情绪、国际市场趋势，以及追单和社区活动的推进速度。
articles.marginDrivers: 关税退款、基础关税成本、降价、固定成本去杠杆、渠道及品类结构，以及激励薪酬应计费用冲回。
articles.guidance: FY2026 收入预计为 103.5 亿至 105 亿美元，同比下降 5% 至 7%；毛利率下降约 80 个基点；摊薄每股收益为 9.48 至 9.73 美元。
articles.risks: 持续客流压力、产品市场反响不确定、中国品牌情绪、季节性清货、固定成本去杠杆和关税退款不确定性。

articles.title: Amer Sports Q2 2026 Earnings Call
articles.summary: Amer Sports Q2 2026 revenue grew 32% reported and 30% ex-currency, led by DTC, Arc’teryx, Salomon and Wilson Tennis 360. Adjusted gross margin rose to 65.8%, with a one-time net tariff refund contributing 390 basis points; underlying gross margin expansion exceeded 300 basis points. Management raised full-year revenue, margin and EPS guidance while continuing to invest in brand, retail and digital capabilities.

articles.title: Birkenstock FY2026 Q3 Earnings Call
articles.summary: Birkenstock 2026 财年第三季度收入按固定汇率增长 15%，DTC 增长 16%并首次超过 B2B，零售收入增长 50%。公司将全年收入增长指引上调至 15%，调整后 EBITDA 指引上调至至少 7.1 亿欧元；毛利率受到外汇、关税、产品组合和物流成本影响。
highlights: 固定汇率收入增长 15%
DTC 增长超过 B2B
自营零售收入增长 50%
全年收入和 EBITDA 指引上调
包头鞋占比提升但带来单位利润改善
articles.revenueDrivers: DTC 和自营零售增长、亚太尤其中国市场、包头鞋和新品、青年消费者及体育用品渠道需求
articles.marginDrivers: 外汇、美国关税、产品组合、产能利用、选择性降价和物流成本
articles.guidance: 全年固定汇率收入增长 15%，调整后 EBITDA 至少 7.1 亿欧元，调整后毛利率 57%至 57.5%
articles.risks: 外汇和美国关税、物流成本、中东地区影响、库存销售比和澳大利亚收入确认节奏

articles.title: On Holding 2026 Q2 Earnings Call
articles.summary: On Holding 2026 年第二季度收入按固定汇率增长 21.6%，直营渠道增长 34.3%，批发渠道管理层主动收紧向渠道发货以保护全价体系和后续新品承接。公司将全年固定汇率收入增长指引维持在低 20% 区间，并将全年毛利率指引上调至至少 65%。
highlights: 直营渠道固定汇率增长 34.3%
批发渠道主动管理发货节奏
毛利率指引上调至至少 65%
新增客群与多品类扩张继续推进
价格区间向更高层级延展
articles.revenueDrivers: 直营渠道增长、欧洲中东及非洲地区表现、运动生活方式和服装品类扩张，以及技术新品带来的需求
articles.marginDrivers: 直营渠道占比提升、全价销售执行、产品与渠道结构，以及批发渠道库存质量管理
articles.guidance: 全年固定汇率收入增长低 20% 区间，绝对收入约 34.7 亿至 35.6 亿瑞士法郎，全年毛利率至少 65.0%，调整后 EBITDA 利润率 19.5% 至 20.0%
articles.risks: 美国多品牌批发市场的促销压力、日常跑步产品售罄偏弱、批发发货节奏和关税退款确认时点

articles.title: Alpargatas 2026 Q2 Earnings Call
articles.summary: Alpargatas Q2 2026 net sales reached R$1.226 billion, up 11.3%, with adjusted EBITDA of R$286 million and a 23.3% margin. Brazil sell-out grew 13%, Europe volume grew 21%, and the U.S. distributor model improved cost efficiency. Rothy's reported US$61.2 million revenue and a 67% gross margin including a tariff refund.
highlights: Global volume increased 9%
Brazil sell-out increased 13%
Europe volume increased 21%
Adjusted EBITDA margin reached 23.3%
Rothy's gross margin included a tariff-refund benefit
articles.revenueDrivers: Brazil volume, premium product mix, Europe recovery, and broader U.S. distribution supported revenue; Rothy's online sales remained soft.
articles.marginDrivers: Manufacturing and logistics efficiency, regional mix, U.S. fixed-cost removal, and scale recovery supported margins; Rothy's reported gross margin included a one-off tariff refund.
articles.guidance: Management did not provide formal guidance and emphasized calibrated growth, price-elasticity-based decisions, and order visibility in the fourth quarter.
articles.risks: Raw-material volatility, foreign exchange, execution capacity, international service levels, estimated sell-out data, and Rothy's online-sales gap.

articles.title: Crocs FY2026 Q2 Earnings Call
articles.summary: Crocs 第二季度收入约 12 亿美元，同比增长 2%；Crocs 品牌首次单季超过 10 亿美元，HEYDUDE 收入下降 6% 但好于预期。直营增长、促销减少和国际市场改善支撑收入，关税使调整后毛利率下降 170 个基点。公司上调全年收入和每股收益指引，并披露一项影响渠道收入确认但不改变终端销量的业务模式调整。
highlights: Crocs brand exceeded $1 billion
Both brands delivered DTC growth
International Crocs revenue grew 7%
HEYDUDE trajectory improved
Full-year revenue and EPS guidance increased
articles.revenueDrivers: International growth, sandals and clog diversification, digital marketplaces, new stores, and improving HEYDUDE direct-to-consumer demand.
articles.marginDrivers: Tariffs, product and channel mix, cost savings, international price increases, and targeted direct-to-consumer investment.
articles.guidance: FY2026 enterprise revenue growth of 1%-2%, Crocs brand growth of 2%-3%, HEYDUDE down 2%-4%, and adjusted diluted EPS of $13.70-$14.00.
articles.risks: North America wholesale declines, revenue-recognition comparability, tariff pressure, HEYDUDE's fourth-quarter acceleration, and channel inventory execution.

articles.title: Deckers FY2027 Q1 Earnings Call
articles.summary: Deckers 第一季度收入 10.2 亿美元，同比增长 5.7%；HOKA 增长 8%，UGG 增长 5%，直营增长继续快于批发。毛利率升至 56.4%，全价销售、渠道结构和清仓管理抵消了部分关税影响。公司维持全年收入区间，并把关税假设从 10% 上调至 12.5%。
highlights: DTC growth led the quarter
Full-price demand remained healthy
Inventory declined 5%
Gross-margin outlook increased
Tariff assumption raised to 12.5%
articles.revenueDrivers: HOKA and UGG full-price demand, international DTC growth, product newness, and later international wholesale shipment timing.
articles.marginDrivers: Favorable channel and product mix, full-price selling, better closeout management, foreign exchange, and tariff pressure.
articles.guidance: FY2027 revenue of $5.86-$5.91 billion, gross margin slightly above 56.5%, operating margin slightly above 21.5%, and diluted EPS of $7.35-$7.50.
articles.risks: Higher tariffs, freight costs, second-half wholesale shipment timing, product transitions, and the durability of full-price demand.
